contours: ../source/acanthus_contours.py, sampled along individual leaf ridges and the eight scrolls. All widths are drawing-plane half-widths. The ratio 720:370 is a reference coordinate grid; actual dimensions are set by the façade fit.
depth: The face-normal depth and rounded ridge sections are model estimates informed by the carved shadow profiles. No measured stone depth is claimed.
nominal_metric_scale: The rectified gable shows about 13 pixels per brick course and 375 pixels per plaque width. A nominal course pitch of 63 mm gives about 1.82 m. There is no tape dimension for the plaque.
metric_frame: The 720×370 traced grid is transformed to the camera-rectified 1.82×1.10 m rectangle. The original four approximate photo corners are retained as tracing controls.
